verdict.rationale: Canny documents automatic feedback capture from Gong, Intercom, Slack and other sources, plus an MCP server for LLM tools, which supports connecting feedback to support/sales/chat tools. However, evidence lacks detail on specific setup/configuration for named integrations (e.g., how Gong/Intercom/Slack connections are configured) or independent corroboration of these integrations working in practice. Missing for 10: detailed integration setup docs for each named tool, independent/hands-on verification, and a public API/OpenAPI reference for custom integrations.
